hints: State the transformation as a translation vector.
walkthrough:
Compare the expressions for $g(x)$ and $h(x)$:
$$g(x) = -(x - 3)^2 - 1$$
$$h(x) = -(x - 3)^2 + 1 = g(x) + 2$$

State the transformation mapping $y = g(x)$ onto $y = h(x)$:
$$\text{A translation by the vector } \begin{pmatrix} 0 \\ 2 \end{pmatrix} \text{ (or } 2 \text{ units vertically upwards)}$$
